message.content: It looks like there’s a mix‑up with the temperature units. Boston’s average high in July is around **70–75 °F (21–24 °C)**, not 54 °C. In fact, 54 °C (≈129 °F) would be far hotter than any recorded temperature in Boston or anywhere in the United States. If you’re looking at a source that lists 54 °C, it’s likely a typo or a conversion error. Boston’s summers are warm but not scorching—most days stay comfortably in the 60–80 °F range.
